items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I had to give Howard job.

ctx.x: Oh, I know. I know. So, and so, well, we played, we had more work than we could play. We had enough work to give three and four bands. We'd give them, give them job. I had to give Howard job. Oh, so many fellas, you know. And the same, you see the same fella played trumpet with the E. Rekker band there. Pazio.
